sentences.dojo_lit: Change the time of day to late at night: outside the windows and the open door it is dark, under a deep blue sky with stars; the moon itself is not in view; and everything that stands outside is still there, as dark shapes, with no window lit. Inside, every one of the hanging lamps is switched on, all of them alike, and together they fill the whole hall with warm, even lamplight and soft shadows; the floor shines warm under them. Add no new lamp, and leave no lamp dark.
